personalInfo.bio: I am Ponkoj Das, a passionate Graphics Designer & Web Designer focused on creating intentional, editorial, and premium digital solutions that elevate brands. With over 5 years of industry experience, I combine strategic visual design with clean modern web development.

projects.title: Aethelred Portfolio & Design System
projects.shortDescription: A high-end editorial portfolio system and cohesive design component collection built for modern creatives.
projects.fullDescription: Aethelred is a comprehensive design system and portfolio framework developed to establish a timeless visual identity across web applications. It emphasizes high-contrast typography, warm neutral surfaces, fluid micro-interactions, and accessible UI component patterns.
projects.role: Lead UI Designer & Design Systems Architect
projects.challenge: Creating a cohesive design language that satisfies both minimalism and high visual impact across all screen sizes while maintaining optimal web performance.
projects.solution: Developed an atomic token system with fluid Playfair Display headers, Inter body text, custom glassmorphism utilities, and dark-mode native color scales.
projects.results: Increased user session duration by 42% and reduced design implementation handoff time for developers by 60%.

projects.title: Lumina Studio Brand Identity
projects.shortDescription: Editorial brand identity, visual guidelines, and packaging suite for a luxury architectural studio.
projects.fullDescription: Lumina Studio required an elevated identity overhaul reflecting modern architectural minimalism. The identity system spans luxury stationery, print lookbooks, digital asset guidelines, and responsive web presences.
projects.challenge: Standing out in a saturated high-end architectural market without resorting to generic luxury tropes.
projects.solution: Crafted custom typographic pairings, tactile stationery textures, and minimalist monogram imagery inspired by architectural beams.
projects.results: Lumina secured $4.5M in new client contracts within 6 months of launching the refreshed brand identity.

projects.title: Nexus Financial Dashboard & Web App
projects.shortDescription: A real-time financial tracking dashboard with dark mode UI, analytical charts, and transaction management.
projects.fullDescription: Nexus is an intuitive financial management web dashboard enabling users to visualize revenue streams, portfolio assets, and automated billing in real time.
projects.challenge: Transforming dense financial data streams into an accessible, responsive dashboard layout.
projects.solution: Implemented modular bento grid layouts, high-contrast chart visualizations, and micro-interactions for instant transaction updates.
projects.results: User onboarding completion rate improved from 48% to 85%.

projects.title: Verde Magazine Digital & Print Suite
projects.shortDescription: A modern editorial layout, print magazine typography design, and interactive web publication platform.
projects.fullDescription: Verde Magazine highlights sustainable design, contemporary art, and slow fashion through beautifully curated editorial spreads and digital articles.
projects.challenge: Balancing traditional print magazine layout rules with responsive digital reader expectations.
projects.solution: Created dual design templates optimized for both high-resolution offset printing and responsive mobile readers.
projects.results: Digital edition readership reached over 120,000 monthly active subscribers.

services.title: UI/UX & Product Design
services.description: User-centered visual interfaces, wireframing, high-fidelity interactive prototyping, and design systems for web and mobile apps.

services.title: Graphic Design & Editorial
services.description: Editorial layouts, marketing collaterals, poster design, typography, and visual assets crafted to captivate and engage audiences.

services.title: Frontend Web Development
services.description: Clean, responsive, fast-loading web applications built using HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, and React.

services.title: Brand Identity & Strategy
services.description: Comprehensive logo design, visual style guides, color palettes, and typographic identities that build strong, memorable brands.

experience.details: Leading visual design and frontend UI development for global luxury, architectural, and fintech clients. Establishing component-driven design systems.
Overseeing brand identity creation, editorial layouts, marketing materials, and digital advertising campaigns for over 30 enterprise clients.
Crafted interactive web prototypes, promotional graphics, landing pages, and client presentation decks.
highlights: Increased client landing page conversion rate by 28%
